description: This file is the main entry point for the AgentField server, written in Go. It sets up command-line interface commands using Cobra, handles configuration loading from files and environment variables, initializes and starts the server, optionally builds a UI, and opens a browser to the UI endpoint.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function acts as the entry point for the server CLI, initializing commands and executing the root command.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Contains the logic to load configuration, set parameters, initialize the server, build UI if needed, and open the browser. Runs the server and waits for shutdown signal.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from specified file, environment variables, and applies defaults. Uses Viper to handle configuration unmarshalling.

methods.name: buildUI
methods.description: Handles the process of building the web UI by running npm commands and setting environment variables for the build.

methods.name: defaultCommandRunner
methods.description: Executes a command in a specified directory with environment variables, forwarding stdout and stderr.

methods.name: defaultBrowserLauncher
methods.description: Launches a URL in the default web browser.

methods.name: defaultStartAgentFieldServer
methods.description: Starts the agent field server instance.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Attempts to open a URL in the default browser based on the OS.
